nodes.label: CEFR level-assignment background job (doc, not loaded)
The level-assignment background job — LLM-only, level_at as the processed flag
nodes.rationale: Chose LLM-only classification over a curated CEFR lexicon (CEFR-J/EVP) because BEA 2025 benchmarks show only a few points of accuracy difference (87.0% best LLM vs 80.7% POS baseline), so going LLM-only deletes the lexicon's licensing minefield, stemmer, and second-normalization complexity for little accuracy cost. level_at (timestamp of attempt, not success) chosen over a boolean 'processed' flag because it also answers 'when' and enables targeted re-processing after a prompt change.
